gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-lexend-tera: Woodgod's lowercase climbs so near the capitals that the heading looks almost uniformly tall, with wide channels cut into each bowl. Lexend Tera loosens everything, with single-weight lines and wide stepping-stone gaps between letters.
gen-fs-bevellier-fs-merriweather-sans: Bevellier has a flat, stencil-cut look, with tightly packed glyphs and squat ascenders over a wide-looking lowercase. Merriweather Sans stands sturdy and tall beside it, each e opening clearly rightward.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-hind: Loud and loose: Revalia strides across widely spaced letters, its lowercase g leaving the lower curve open. Hind holds steady, strokes taut as drawn string, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-megrim-fs-nunito: Sharp and futuristic: Megrim ends every stroke at a measured thickness, its c open like a bent paperclip. And Nunito softens it all with big round lowercase bowls and terminals that stop short of the stem.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-quicksand: Bookish, nostalgic: Mystery Quest keeps its ascenders compact over a tall lowercase, every curved stroke showing open jaws. Quicksand drifts in with blown-glass bowls and bars of identical thickness throughout.
gen-fs-expose-archivo: Archivo reads with an editorial confidence, its curves opening outward instead of curling in under a commanding x-height. And if Expose gets made small, its compressed cadence loses the punch it has up large.
gen-fs-expose-fs-epilogue: Striking and tightly compressed, Expose leaves almost no gap between its x-height and the capitals. Epilogue then runs on page after page with curvy, wire-like monoline letters that feel unclamped.
gen-fs-expose-fs-fira-sans: Tight and striking, Expose packs its capitals and lowercase almost shoulder to shoulder with barely a pause. Fira Sans counters with equal-width strokes and s curves flaring at both ends.
gen-fs-expose-work-sans: Work Sans holds its strokes as constant as bent wire. Text moves along easily under its high mean line, c tips that never creep toward touching, while Expose stays compressed and striking above.
gen-fs-nippo-manrope: Manrope holds one pen-like width, with a bright gap in every curve. Nippo's wire-cut, almost-capital lowercase adds a technical edge up top, and Manrope's minimal cap-to-lowercase step keeps the two close kin.
